本来还水泄不通的飞升台，分分钟就空荡荡的，连个鬼影都看不到。

这里没有什么云雾缭绕，也没有什么大气恢弘的建筑，就特么是个玉石铺砌的空地，飞升台在空地的正中央。

远处是层峦起伏的山脉，隐约能看到建筑。

凤辞毫无感觉的牵着时笙走下飞升台。

“刚才那些人是来干什么的？”时笙不解的问。

“不知道。”凤辞迷茫摇头。

时笙：“……”你丫的是不是仙界的人？

安静下来的飞升台忽然又有了动静，时笙皱眉看过去，还有人飞升？

最近是飞升的好日子吗？

然而出现在飞升台上的却是个很熟悉的身影，叶清秋！

这丫的不是比她早飞升吗？怎么还落到她后面了？

飞升也能整出幺蛾子，女主你牛啊！

叶清秋也看到了时笙，脸色瞬间难看起来，眸光阴沉，戒备又憎恶的盯着时笙。

就在此时，刚才跑得没影的人，从四面八方冒出来，一窝蜂的围向叶清秋，也不管她愿意不愿意，七手八脚的拽着她就跑，眨眼就没了踪迹。

时笙：“……”感情这些人是来接叶清秋的？

女主大人的待遇就是好，就算没了男主，还有这么多人来接她。

时笙不知道，其实这些人大多数是来围观她的，只是因为她和凤辞站一块，他们哪里敢围观。

“你想住哪里？”凤辞认真的问。

“还能选？”仙界这么人性化？

凤辞笑了一下，霸气的道：“你想住哪里，我就给抢哪里。”

时笙：“……”

我想住仙帝的仙宫！

“你住哪里？”时笙怕自己说出来，凤辞真的会带她去抢仙帝的仙宫，然后她飞升的第一时间就特么扬名仙界了。

凤辞目光闪了闪，谨慎又小心的问：“小殊……想住我住的地方？”

“不行吗？”这话问得都不像是凤辞了，他平时那是恨不得把她全身上下都贴上凤辞专属，怎么这会儿……

时笙狐疑的看向凤辞，身为大反派，不应该住得特别差吧？

凤辞抿了抿唇角，眼底有些挣扎，最后他还是缓慢的点头。

The ascension platform, which was originally filled with water, became empty within minutes, and not even a ghost could be seen.

There are no clouds and mist here, and there are no majestic buildings. It is just an open space paved with jade, and the ascension platform is in the center of the open space.

In the distance are rolling mountains, and buildings can be vaguely seen.

Feng Ci led Shi Sheng down the ascension platform without any feeling.

"What did those people do just now?" Shi Sheng asked in confusion.

"I don't know." Feng Ci shook his head in confusion.

Shi Sheng: "..." Are you from the fairy world?

The quiet ascension platform suddenly started to move again. Shi Sheng frowned and looked over. Is there anyone else ascending?

Is it a good time to ascend recently?

However, what appeared on the ascension platform was a very familiar figure, Ye Qingqiu!

Didn't this girl ascend earlier than her?Why are you still lagging behind her?

Ascension can also bring out evil spirits, the heroine, you are awesome!

Ye Qingqiu also saw Shi Sheng, his face instantly turned ugly, his eyes were gloomy, staring at Shi Sheng with caution and hatred.

At this moment, the people who had just disappeared appeared from all directions and swarmed around Ye Qingqiu. Regardless of whether she wanted to or not, they dragged her away and disappeared in the blink of an eye.

Shi Sheng: "..." Are these people here to pick up Ye Qingqiu?

The treatment of the heroine is good. Even if the hero is gone, there are still so many people coming to pick her up.

Shi Sheng didn't know that most of these people were actually here to watch her, just because she and Feng Ci were standing together, so they didn't dare to watch.

"Where do you want to live?" Feng Ci asked seriously.

"Can I still choose?" Is the fairy world so humane?

Feng Ci smiled and said domineeringly: "Wherever you want to live, I will grab it for you."

Shi Sheng: "..."

I want to live in the Immortal Emperor’s Immortal Palace!

"Where do you live?" Shi Sheng was afraid that if she said it, Feng Ci would really take her to rob the Immortal Emperor's Immortal Palace, and then she would become famous in the Immortal World as soon as she ascended.

Feng Ci's eyes flashed, and he asked cautiously and cautiously: "Xiao Shu...want to live where I live?"

"Can't you?" He didn't sound like Feng Ci anymore when he asked this question. He usually wanted to cover her whole body with Feng Ci's exclusive label, but why now...

Shi Sheng looked at Feng Ci suspiciously. As a villain, he shouldn't live in a particularly bad place, right?

Feng Ci pursed his lips, and there was some struggle in his eyes, but in the end he nodded slowly.
